_comment: Single source of truth for every third-party asset. tools/fetch_assets.py downloads from it and regenerates ASSET_CREDITS.md from it. Add an asset here only after reading its license on the source page yourself.

assets.name: Space Kit (150 models)
assets.creator: Kenney
assets.verified: 2026-11-08: pack page states 'Creative Commons CC0'
assets.used_for: Habitat, greenhouse dome, oxygen plant, water/oxygen/food tanks, battery bank, comms dish, lander (stacked rocket parts), exploration rover (scenery), static astronaut fallback

assets.name: Space Station Kit (90 models)
assets.creator: Kenney
assets.verified: 2026-11-08: pack page states 'Creative Commons CC0'
assets.used_for: Downloaded for habitat interiors, airlocks, doors and lab furniture (not placed in a scene yet)

assets.name: Sci-fi Sounds (70 sounds)
assets.creator: Kenney
assets.verified: 2026-11-08: pack page states 'Creative Commons CC0'
assets.used_for: Downloaded for machinery, airlock, UI and lab sound effects (not wired to gameplay yet)

assets.name: Impact Sounds (130 sounds)
assets.creator: Kenney
assets.verified: 2026-11-08: pack page states 'Creative Commons CC0'
assets.used_for: Downloaded for footsteps and impacts (not wired to gameplay yet)

assets.name: Ultimate Space Kit (92 models, animated characters)
assets.creator: Quaternius
assets.license: CC0 1.0 (as stated on the pack page)
assets.verified: 2026-11-08: pack page states 'License CC0'. Quaternius' site-wide license page now shows the Quaternius Asset License v1.0 (dated 2026-08-28) for newer releases, which forbids redistributing the raw assets. We keep raw Quaternius files out of git either way.
assets.used_for: Animated astronaut rigs (4 characters, 18 clips incl. Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, Wave), worn with our visor and backpack

assets.name: Ultimate Crops Pack (100+ crops, 5 growth stages)
assets.creator: Quaternius
assets.license: CC0 1.0 (as stated on the pack page)
assets.verified: 2026-11-08: pack page states 'License CC0'. Same QAL note as the Ultimate Space Kit.
assets.used_for: Growth-stage models for lettuce, potato, tomato, wheat and other crops (until fetched, beds use a primitive fallback)

assets.name: Ground textures: Red Sand, Cracked Red Ground, Red Laterite Soil Stones
assets.creator: Poly Haven (Rohit Seervi; Amal Kumar)
assets.verified: 2026-11-08: polyhaven.com/license states all assets are CC0

assets.name: Rock Boulder Dry (texture)
assets.creator: Poly Haven (Dimitrios Savva, Rico Cilliers)
assets.verified: 2026-11-08: polyhaven.com/license states all assets are CC0

generated.name: Phobos and Deimos meshes
generated.how: IrregularMoonMesh.cs: cratered, noise-displaced ellipsoids at real dimensions (Phobos 26.8 x 22.4 x 18.4 km with a Stickney-size crater; Deimos 15.0 x 12.2 x 10.4 km)

generated.name: Boulders, rocks and ice crystals
generated.how: RockMeshFactory.cs: flat-shaded, noise-displaced icospheres and hexagonal ice prisms, drawn with GPU instancing by RockScatter.cs

generated.name: Craters, dunes and the colony pad
generated.how: MarsTerrainGenerator.cs: heightmap craters (bowl, rim, ejecta), asymmetric dune field, slope-based texture painting

generated.name: Black hole, accretion disk, gravitational lensing
generated.how: BlackHoleLensing.shader: per-pixel Schwarzschild photon-path integration with Doppler and gravitational shifts. No images are used.

generated.name: Solar panel array
generated.how: AssetIntegrationBuilder.cs: Unity primitives (no free panel model in the packs)

generated.name: Astronaut sun visor and life-support backpack
generated.how: AstronautSuit.cs: primitives attached to the rig's head and torso bones

generated.name: Planet spheres and Saturn's ring
generated.how: MeshBuilders.cs: equirectangular UV sphere and a radial-UV ring

manual_only.name: Unity Asset Store free packs
manual_only.why: Downloads need a signed-in Unity account and the Asset Store EULA, so they cannot be scripted. Add each one through Package Manager > My Assets, then add a manifest entry with method 'manual'.

manual_only.name: Sketchfab models
manual_only.why: Downloads need a signed-in account, and the license differs per model. Only CC0 or CC BY models qualify; record each one here before importing.
